selectedWork.headline: Operational problems solved with data and systems.
selectedWork.intro: A selection of professional work involving system migration, automation, reporting architecture, operational analysis, data quality, and process improvement.

items.title: CRM Migration & Reporting Rebuild
items.summary: Supported the move from NetForum to Salesforce/Nimble AMS by validating converted data, reconciling relationships, and rebuilding recurring reporting processes.
items.challenge: Legacy reports depended on data structures and business logic that did not translate directly into the new CRM. Converted records and relationships needed to be checked before recurring processes could rely on them.
items.role: Supported migration validation, investigated discrepancies, and rebuilt recurring reports and processes for the new environment.
items.approach: Traced legacy reporting logic, compared records across systems, and reconciled identifiers and relationships. Adapted the reporting work as mapping and conversion requirements changed.
items.outcome: Recurring reporting processes were rebuilt against Salesforce/Nimble AMS, with conversion discrepancies and relationship issues investigated to support operational use.

items.title: Marketing Audience Automation Ecosystem
items.summary: Built and maintained recurring SQL-driven audience processes connecting CRM, membership, exhibitor, council/network, and marketing data, with consistent segmentation, exclusions, refreshes, and validation.
items.challenge: Recurring campaigns drew on fragmented sources and changing eligibility rules. Isolated audience requests made it difficult to keep segmentation, suppression, and email hygiene consistent.
items.role: Built and maintained recurring audience and data workflows supporting marketing operations.
items.approach: Translated campaign requirements into maintainable SQL processes, standardized segmentation and exclusion logic, and incorporated recurring refreshes, email-hygiene checks, validation, and operational monitoring.
items.outcome: Campaign support became a repeatable data-operations workflow, with more consistent audience rules and refresh checks across recurring processes.

items.title: AR Aging Reporting Architecture
items.summary: Translates Finance’s AR Aging needs into Salesforce/Nimble reporting logic, working through order-versus-line granularity, bundle behavior, and balance exceptions to validate meaningful outstanding receivables.
items.challenge: Order balances and their underlying lines can tell different stories. Bundles and negative lines beneath positive overall balances complicate which receivables should appear in an aging report.
items.role: Investigates transactional relationships and develops and validates the reporting logic with Finance’s reporting needs in view.
items.approach: Works through Order Item and Order Item Line granularity, checks bundle behavior and balance exceptions, and tests what should surface as outstanding receivables.
items.outcome: The investigation has clarified the order-versus-line and balance-exception decisions needed for usable AR Aging reporting. Those decisions are being validated against Finance’s needs.

items.title: ESRA Warm/Hot Lead System
items.summary: Improved and maintained a repeatable Warm/Hot lead process that turns business and engagement data into qualified Sales outputs through refined refresh logic, qualification rules, and automation.
items.challenge: Business and engagement data needed to become useful Sales information through qualification rules and a consistent recurring refresh process.
items.role: Improved and maintained the operating lead process, its reporting structure, and supporting automation.
items.approach: Refined recurring refresh logic and qualification rules, structured the Warm/Hot lead outputs, and improved repeatability while continuing to refine the process.
items.outcome: An operating, repeatable process supplies qualified Warm/Hot lead information to Sales, with more consistent refreshes and supporting automation.

items.title: Booth Space Selection Process Overhaul
items.summary: Redesigned recurring booth-space-selection reporting into a structured, documented workflow that nontechnical staff could operate with less repeated technical intervention.
items.challenge: A troublesome recurring reporting process depended on repeated technical intervention and needed a clearer workflow for the staff using it.
items.role: Redesigned the reporting process and documented how staff could operate it.
items.approach: Worked through the existing workflow, improved its reporting and data flow, and organized the recurring steps into a documented, repeatable process.
items.outcome: Nontechnical staff could operate more of the process themselves, with a clearer workflow and less dependence on repeated technical support.

items.title: Membership Alignment & Financial Analysis
items.summary: Analyzed national and chapter membership relationships, gain/loss patterns, and associated financial impact, turning complex membership data into reporting stakeholders could interpret and use.
items.challenge: Complex national and chapter membership relationships made alignment and net gain/loss patterns difficult to interpret alongside their financial implications.
items.role: Analyzed membership alignment and financial impact, then translated the findings into stakeholder reporting.
items.approach: Examined national and chapter relationships, compared alignment and gain/loss patterns, and organized the financial analysis into interpretable reporting.
items.outcome: Stakeholders gained a clearer view of membership alignment, gain/loss patterns, and their associated financial impact to support decisions.

items.title: Historical Exhibitor Reconstruction
items.summary: Mapped when organizations first exhibited across roughly 8,000 historical records to distinguish first-time and returning exhibitors.

items.title: Council Affiliation Reconciliation
items.summary: Designed matching logic and resolved historical relationship conflicts and merged-record exceptions across approximately 4,000 council-affiliation records.

items.title: Data-Quality Monitoring / Operational Audits
items.summary: Built recurring audits for contact, relationship, and record-quality risks, identifying 473 organizations missing primary contacts and helping distinguish record errors from configuration problems.
